cards.t: Russia Finalizes Crypto Trading Rules for Retail
cards.b: Russia has finalized its retail crypto trading rules ahead of a November 17 rollout, allowing retail investors to trade Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT via regulated intermediaries.

per.BTC: Retail access via regulated intermediaries rolls out on November 17.
per.ETH: Retail access via regulated intermediaries rolls out on November 17.
per.USDT: Retail access via regulated intermediaries rolls out on November 17.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Full list of approved regulated intermediaries beyond the Moscow Exchange's planned December crypto trading launch

cards.b: Zcash successfully launched its NU7 network upgrade on mainnet, reducing block times threefold and activating the Network Sustainability Mechanism which recycles 60% of fees, though it stranded about 12,224 ZEC in the legacy Sprout pool.

per.ZEC: NU7 upgrade went live, cutting block time threefold and stranding legacy Sprout funds while recycling fees.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Whether access to the stranded Sprout pool funds will be permanently lost or restored in a future upgrade
